verdict.rationale: Evidence covers individual key setup, CLI device listing/config (`solo2 list`, `admin set led`), and custom attestation-key generation, with one offhand mention of building attestation keys 'for maybe 100,000 devices'—but there is no documented bulk-enrollment workflow, admin console, pre-registration pipeline, or lifecycle/issuance tracking system for organizations. Runtime probes further show the official CLI is broken (ImportError) and no firmware has shipped in 4 years, undercutting any claim of active enterprise tooling.
